changelog:
- Initial release of Codex Pet — Pro Pack for RunComfy.
- Generate a custom Codex Pet for OpenAI Codex from a single reference image; outputs compatible spritesheet.webp (1536x1872, 8x9 grid) and pet.json manifest.
- Uses RunComfy CLI (runcomfy + magick) with only one OpenAI GPT Image 2 call per pet; no Codex Pro, `$imagegen`, or OPENAI_API_KEY required.
- Produces all 9 Codex Pet animation states programmatically via ImageMagick micro-transforms for subtle, native-style animation.
- Simple install: drop the output into `${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/pets/<name>/` for instant Codex detection.
- Triggers on various "codex pet"-related keywords and supports batch generation.
display_name: Codex Pet — Pro Pack on RunComfy
summary: Codex Pet generator on RunComfy. Build a Codex-compatible Codex Pet spritesheet.webp + pet.json from a single reference image, drop it into `${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/pets/<name>/` and Codex picks it up as a custom Codex Pet next to the 8 built-ins. This skill produces the exact Codex Pet atlas Codex expects (1536x1872 PNG/WebP, 8 cols x 9 rows, 192x208 cells, 9 animation states — idle, running-right, running-left, waving, jumping, failed, waiting, running, review). Calls OpenAI GPT Image 2 edit ONCE via the local RunComfy CLI as `runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/edit` to produce a canonical Codex Pet pose, then assembles all 9 animation rows programmatically with ImageMagick micro-transforms — no Codex Pro, no `$imagegen`, no OPENAI_API_KEY required, only RUNCOMFY_TOKEN. Triggers on "codex pet", "create codex pet", "make codex pet", "hatch codex pet", "/hatch image", "desktop pet codex", "codex pets", "spritesheet.webp", or any explicit ask to build a custom pet for OpenAI Codex.
